display.purpose: Page titles, publisher names, article titles. Never below 1.5rem (The Playfair Threshold Rule).

body.purpose: All prose and working UI text. Reading column max-w-3xl, line-height ≥1.6.

label.purpose: Dates, counts, statuses, slugs. Uppercase micro variant at 0.5625rem/0.1em tracking.

shadows.name: floating-overlay
shadows.purpose: Context menus and dialogs only — nothing resting in the page flow casts a shadow (The Hairline Rule).

motion.name: state-ease
motion.purpose: Default for hover and state transitions; no choreography, no bounce.

motion.name: bar-ease
motion.purpose: Data bars animate via scaleX, never width.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one standard primary action across the app (themed-btn-accent rounded-lg).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #6366f1); color: var(--accent-foreground, #ffffff); border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #6366f1); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions — hairline border, ink text.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--foreground, #18181b); border: 1px solid var(--border, #e4e4e7); border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 0.4375rem 1rem; font-size: 0.8125rem; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: var(--input-focus-border, #a1a1aa); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #6366f1); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard field — hairline stroke, focus border shift.
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--foreground, #18181b); border: 1px solid var(--input-border, #e4e4e7); border-radius: 0.375rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; width: 100%; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--input-focus-border, #a1a1aa); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, #71717a); }

components.name: Tag Pill
components.description: Outlined pill for tags; uppercase mono micro variant for statuses.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e4e4e7); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted-foreground, #71717a); } .ds-tag-status { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.5625rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview: Hushed authority, knowledge at rest, comfort measured in hours rather than glances. Playfair Display carries editorial weight at display sizes; Geist Sans does the working text; a monospace whisper handles dates, counts, and slugs. Depth comes from hairline borders and surface tone, never decoration. The single indigo accent — Quiet Iris — speaks rarely, which is why it is heard.
keyCharacteristics: Serif gravitas at display sizes only; sans for all working UI
One accent, used at ≤10% of any screen
Depth = 1px hairline + surface tone; shadows reserved for floating overlays
Built for the long session: generous line-height, restrained motion, WCAG AA contrast

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Quiet Iris appears on at most 10% of any screen — primary actions, selection, focus. Everything else is ink, graphite, and tone.

rules.name: The Token Rule
rules.body: Every color goes through a CSS custom property. Hardcoding a hex in a component is prohibited; users retheme all 15 tokens.

rules.name: The Playfair Threshold Rule
rules.body: Playfair Display appears only at display sizes (≥1.5rem). It is forbidden in buttons, labels, body text, or data.

rules.name: The Mono Fact Rule
rules.body: Numbers about the system (counts, dates, versions, statuses) render in the mono metadata style, never bold.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: If an element rests in the page flow, its depth budget is one 1px border and one surface-tone step. A resting card with a shadow is drift.

dos: Do route every color through the theme tokens; the 15-token light/dark system is the single source of truth.
Do pair themed-btn-accent with rounded-lg — that pairing IS the primary button.
Do use hairline dividers and surface tone for structure; reach for the list-row pattern before inventing a card.
Do mark metadata (dates, counts, statuses) in the mono micro-label style.
Do keep reading columns at max-w-3xl and body line-height ≥1.6 — the long session is the product.
Do honor reduced motion and the global :focus-visible accent ring.
donts: Don't ship Web-1.0 academic rawness — unstyled density, default-font dumps, naked tables. Rigor must be typeset.
Don't build the cluttered wiki — no boxes-within-boxes, no sidebar chrome fighting prose, no link thickets in the reading column.
Don't hardcode a color value in a component; only the fixed semantic tokens are literal.
Don't use side-stripe accents (border-left > 1px) on cards, banners, or list items; blockquote/callout 2px quote rules are the sole exception.
Don't put Playfair in buttons, labels, or data.
Don't add resting shadows, gradients, or glassmorphism — depth is hairline + tone.
Don't let Quiet Iris exceed ~10% of a screen.
